title: A Unifying View of Distributionally Robust Optimization for Probability Smoothing via Maximum Entropy
summary: The probability smoothing problem seeks estimators that assign positive probability to all categories, including those unobserved in a finite sample. In our previous work, we established that the estimator derived from distributionally robust optimization (DRO) with a $q$-norm ambiguity set ($q$-DRO) satisfies the axioms of Positivity, Symmetry, and Order Preservation, while relaxing the rigid Ratio Preservation axiom characterizing Laplace smoothing.
